cold_reset.evidence: s0_n1/launch.py process(): subprocess.Popen of a fresh Python worker, serial wait, cache snapshots and frozen load hashes
cold_reset.limit: Process isolation excludes persistence of Python globals. A dedicated same-machine before/after replay is newly scheduled; OS effects are not ruled out by process isolation alone.

serialization.scope: Actual archived BG2000 generation before writing versus loaded text; not just text-file hashes

generation_difference.origin: Upstream shipped table versus current pinned generator/background realization; original generation environment is not reconstructed

rate_grid_neutron_tail_diagnostic.conditional: Three-point Richardson diagnostic only; requires asymptotic power law and fixed other errors. Not a certified bound.

Neff.dependency: PRIMAT.main._build_results reads background.rho_nu_total_final; standard background uses fixed NEVO temperature tables at fixed T_end. Nuclear-network convergence cannot independently validate neutrino decoupling.
Neff.published_benchmark: 3.0440 +/- 0.0002 in this cited paper, not a universal certification

D_over_H.interpretation: Deterministic difference between controlled numerical configurations, not a measured stochastic noise floor. Run index is not physical time. No requirement for different discretizations to collapse onto coarse R0.
D_over_H.literature_limit: That paper obtains 2.442 +/- 0.040 times 1e-5 with Planck and 1.70 sigma versus Cooke; significance is dataset/rate dependent and is not calculated for our run.
